tools.zapret.missing: Zapret files are missing or quarantined. Restore the official release, download the pinned engine, or choose a folder. See the testing guide for recovery.

tools.tg.cf: Cloudflare fallback when WebSocket is unavailable
tools.tg.runtime.hint: BYDLO installs the pinned tg-ws-proxy package into a private Python environment (needs Python 3.9+). Or point to an existing tg-ws-proxy executable.
tools.tg.notelegram: Telegram did not open. Copy the link and send it to yourself in Telegram.
tools.tg.secret.restart: New secret generated. Restart TgWsProxy and update Telegram.
tools.engines.hint: BYDLO downloads pinned versions and verifies their SHA-256. WireGuard, AmneziaWG and OpenVPN use their official installed clients.
routing.subtitle: Split tunneling, DNS and rules. Applied on the next connect.

routing.private.hint: Home router, printers and LAN stay direct.
routing.only.hint: Everything else goes direct (split tunneling, include mode).
routing.process.hint: Process names, e.g. game.exe. Only works in TUN mode.

settings.sysproxy.hint: Windows only. The previous proxy settings are restored on disconnect.
settings.mock.hint: Simulates connecting, traffic and errors. No engine is started and no traffic is carried. For UI testing only.

about.text: Free and open-source launcher for VPNs, proxies and open-internet tools. BYDLO is a front-end: the real work is done by the projects below. Huge thanks to their authors.
orphans.text: Engines from a previous session are still running.
tools.zapret.native: Administrator / root required. User lists are saved in BYDLO data and survive application updates. Native presets are separate from Flowseal strategies; effectiveness depends on your network.
tools.zapret.macos: macOS: IPv4 TCP 80/443 only. No UDP/QUIC, IPv6 or game filter. Root traffic is excluded. Requires root, a free port 21771 and the standard com.apple/* PF anchors. User lists survive updates.
tools.zapret.stopupdate: Stop Zapret before updating its managed files.
about.zapret.native: winws / nfqws / tpws: handling DPI filtering; MIT license included in the release.
about.cygwin: Windows runtime for winws. Linking Exception, license and corresponding source included in the release.
about.newlib: Cygwin C library; additional license notices included in the release.
settings.killswitch: Block Internet if the VPN disconnects (TUN / sing-box)
settings.killswitch.warning: Warning: Internet stays blocked during VPN failure and reconnection until you disconnect. LAN and mesh exceptions follow Routing settings; other direct/split rules are ignored. Requires a running TUN guard; a guard crash or forced termination can release protection. To restore access, use Disable kill switch and disconnect, or close BYDLO. After an app crash, restart BYDLO with the same privileges to release the old TUN.
settings.killswitch.ack: I understand the warning and how to restore access
settings.killswitch.active: Enabled for the next TUN connection. Local proxy mode is unaffected.
settings.killswitch.next: Kill switch will apply on the next TUN connection.
settings.killswitch.recovery: Could not stop the old TUN. Restart BYDLO with the same administrator/root rights and try again.
error.killswitch.active: A kill switch TUN is already active. Disconnect first.
error.killswitch.tun: The kill switch TUN stopped. Protection may be unavailable. Disconnect before connecting again.
error.killswitch.engine: Kill switch requires sing-box in TUN mode. Disable it in Settings to use this engine.

settings.associations.hint: Windows only, off by default. Register BYDLO for .conf/.ovpn Open with and protocol links. File defaults are preserved. Click Register to consent. Move the app first to its permanent location. Linux/macOS registration is planned.
